senses.gloss:
ऋजिप्य ऋजिप्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. ऋञ्ज्?), Ved.
going quick, striving upwards; [cf. Zend. ĕrĕzifja.]

ऋजिश्वन् ऋजिश्वन्, आ, m., Ved., N. of a man
(protected by Indra) who has the epithet Vaidathina.

ऋजीक ऋजीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. अर्ज्), Ved.
coloured, variegated; mixed with; polluted; (अस्), m.
smoke; an epithet of Indra; N. of a mountain.
ऋजीति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. burning, sparkling.

ऋजीष ऋजीष, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. ऋञ्ज्?), Ved.
epithet of Indra, carrying or driving away, (or perhaps
= ऋजीषिन् below); (अम्), n. the sediment or residue
of Soma; a frying-pan; N. of a hell; (Sāy.) water.
